guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 在 X 上关注 Flop Labs
guide.description: 关注 Flop Labs X 官方账号并打开通知。这是该项目发布的唯一资格要求，也是测试网日期最先到达的地方。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Follow the official Flop Labs X account and turn on notifications. This is the only requirement the project has published for eligibility, and it is where testnet dates will land first.

guide.title: 跟随 Arthur Hayes 学习早期课程
guide.description: 关注 CryptoHayes 并订阅他的 Substack。他的文章比项目账户更详细，包括 20% 的测试网数据，还有更多。术语往往首先浮出水面。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Follow Arthur Hayes for early terms
guide.original_description: Follow CryptoHayes and subscribe to his Substack. His essays have carried more detail than the project account, including the 20% testnet figure, and more are coming. Terms tend to surface there first.

guide.title: 申请网络角色
guide.description: 打开 Flop 网站，提交与你可以提供的服务相匹配的表格。四个角色中有三个是开放的： GPU 提供商或矿工：适用于任何具有硬件可以运行推理的人。矿工可获得区块奖励以及每项工作的报酬。尚未发布最低规格，因此将任何循环硬件要求视为未经验证。验证者：确认矿工已完成其分配的工作并存储代理内存。 适合人们舒适地运行节点。KOL 或创作者：三者中最低的障碍。几个可靠的帖子加上表格是入门价格，子堆栈计数，如果你的 X 账户很弱，这会有所帮助。第四个角色，代理，是需求方：他们花费 $FLOP 而不是赚取它，所以没有什么可以申请的。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the Flop website and submit the form matching what you can deliver. Three of the four roles are open: GPU provider or miner: for anyone with hardware that can run inference. Miners earn block rewards plus payment per job. No minimum specifications have been published, so treat any circulating hardware requirement as unverified. Validator: confirms miners completed their assigned work and stores agent memory. Suited to people comfortable running nodes. KOL or creator: the lowest barrier of the three. A few solid posts plus the form is the entry price, and Substack counts, which helps if your X account is weak. The fourth role, Agents, is the demand side: they spend $FLOP rather than earn it, so there is nothing to apply for.

guide.title: 立即开始发布 $FLOP 内容
guide.description: 如果你选择了创作者路线，请在计划正式开启前发布。目前还没有排行榜，如果评分最终以心态为基础，它很可能会被追溯应用。保持主题：去中心化推理、GPU 经济学、Hayes 关于人工智能构建是一个债务问题而不是技术问题的论点。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: If you took the creator route, post before the program formally opens. There is no leaderboard yet, and if scoring ends up mindshare-based it will likely be applied retroactively. Stay on theme: decentralized inference, GPU economics, Hayes’ argument that the AI buildout is a debt problem rather than a technology one.

guide.title: 为第 4 季度测试网做好准备
guide.description: 20 ％的分配是在尚未打开的测试网上获得的。推迟为特定网络配置钱包，因为 Flop Labs 尚未命名链。观看官方账号，并准备好上线接单。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Get ready for the Q4 testnet
guide.original_description: The 20% allocation is earned on the testnet, which has not opened. Hold off on configuring a wallet for a specific network, because Flop Labs has not named the chain. Watch the official account and be ready to onboard when it goes live.

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
相关活动信息待核实，请查看官方公告。
